title: SEC Punts Controversial Short-Sale Disclosure Deadline Again
content: The US Securities and Exchange Commission delayed for the second time this year the deadline for hedge funds and other big investors to comply with much-watched disclosure rules for short selling and related stock lending.

title: Canada's EQB to Buy Banking Unit of Country's Largest Supermarket Chain
content: Canadian lender EQB Inc. is buying the banking division of the country’s largest supermarket chain to boost its deposit and credit card businesses.

title: Goldman Is Pitching a Risky $500 Million Deal to Finance Shareholder Payout
content: A Canadian benefits provider owned by Goldman Sachs Group Inc. is seeking around $500 million from private credit lenders to finance a payout to shareholders, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Stocks Higher on Fed Cut Bets | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 12/03/2025
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss how today's ADP report adds to more evidence of a US labor market slowdown, plus earnings results from Macy's and Dollar Tree. Bloomberg's Stuart Paul and Emily Cohn join the show to discuss. Plus, LendingClub CEO Scott Sanborn discusses the state of US consumer credit and the company's push into home improvement financing, Bloomberg's Keith Naughton discusses President Trump's plan to unwind Biden-era car mileage mandates. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: LendingClub's Sanborn on the State of Consumer Credit
content: LendingClub CEO Scott Sanborn discusses the company's customer base, the state of the US credit market and current credit card rates. He speaks with Tim Stenovec, Carol Massar and Herman Chan on 'Bloomberg Businessweek Daily.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asia Centric: 2026 Lookahead for Stocks, Bonds and Currencies
content: It’s time to look ahead and make bold predictions for Asia in 2026. After a standout year, Asian equities are on track to beat the S&P 500 by the widest margin in eight years. Can the rally continue, and which markets will lead? Are investors overlooking US funding stress, potential QE, and the risks behind multi-decade tight credit spreads? And what’s next for Asian currencies and gold?

title: Oracle Credit Fear Gauge Hits Highest Since 2009 on AI Bubble Fears
content: A credit-risk gauge on Oracle Corp. debt closed at the highest level since the financial crisis after a flood of bond sales from tech giants amplified concerns that a bubble is forming in the artificial-intelligence industry.

title: Lagarde Says ECB Won’t Violate EU Treaty Over Russian Assets

title: Carbon Market ‘More Bullish’ After Alberta Price Commitment

title: UK to End Pause on Handling Car Loan Complaints on May 31
